## Checklist

- [ ] I edited files in `src/` (not the generated `themes/` or `icons/`) and ran `node build.mjs`.
- [ ] `node scripts/check.mjs` ends with `ok`.
- [ ] The generated files are committed together with the `src/` change, including new ones.
- [ ] For new logos in Serena Icons: the license allows modification, the owner's brand or trademark page was read and does not forbid recoloring or require permission, and the credit is in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] Screenshots of the result (before and after) are attached, if the change is visible.
